specialization.cap.training: Your specialization holds {stat} at {cap}: no trainer takes you further.
specialization.cap.book: You learn nothing new of {stat}: your specialization holds it at {cap}.
specialization.cap.potion: This potion would fortify {stat}, which your specialization does not master.
specialization.unknown: The mentor knows no such specialization.
specialization.not_taught: This mentor does not teach {specialization}. Look for another mentor, or the Imperial Registrar.
specialization.busy: Your choice is still being written down. Wait a moment.
specialization.too_soon: You changed your specialization not long ago. You can change it again in {wait}.
specialization.too_poor: Taking up {specialization} costs {price} gold and you carry {gold}.
specialization.chosen: Your specialization is {specialization} now. Your skills grow as far as it allows.
specialization.changed: Your specialization is {specialization} now, in place of {old}, for {price} gold. Skills above your new limits are lowered to them.
specialization.failed: The choice could not be written down. You kept your gold.
specialization.lost: The choice could not be written down, and your gold could not be given back. Tell the staff.
specialization.unreadable: The mentor cannot find your records right now. Try again in a moment.
specialization.closed_far: You walked more than {metres} m away from the mentor.
specialization.closed_not_in_world: You left the world, so the mentor's window closed.
specialization.cmd.spec: /aspec <player> <specialization|none> - set a character's specialization, free and without a cooldown, or take it away
specialization.cmd.cap: /acap <player> <attribute or skill> <0-100|clear> - set a cap in place of the specialization's, or take it off
specialization.cmd.stat: /astat <player> <attribute or skill> <0-100> - set the value of an attribute or a skill, at most its cap
specialization.staff.unknown: No specialization "{word}". The specializations: {names}, or none.
specialization.staff.unknown_stat: No attribute or skill "{word}". Name one as the game does, such as Strength or HandToHand.
specialization.staff.cap_range: A cap is 0 to {max}, or clear.
specialization.staff.value_over_cap: {stat} is capped at {cap} for this character. Raise the cap first with /acap.
specialization.staff.not_read: The specialization of {name} is not read yet. Try again in a moment.
specialization.staff.failed: The change could not be written down. Nothing changed.
specialization.staff.cap_cleared: {stat} of {name} has the specialization's cap again.
specialization.staff.notice_cleared: The staff took your specialization away. A mentor or the Imperial Registrar teaches a new one.
